thread:
lia: heads up — saw reproducible token offset drift when warmstarting KV on atlas-28k int4 during longprefill smoke.
omar: can you paste repro steps?
lia: short: run longprefill harness with anchor tokens at positions near 8k, then warmstart a replica and compare anchor token logits. command: `./tools/long_prefill --model atlas-28k --quant int4 --tokens 12000 --anchor pos=8192`
sasha: results? numbers?
lia: baseline (no warmstart): 0/500 anchor divergences. warmstart at iteration 50 -> 7/500 divergences (mostly off-by-1 logits at positions 8189-8195). sample logs:
```
[2024-06-03T14:02:11Z] warmstart: shard=3 snapshot=2024-06-03-13:58 id=ws-58
[2024-06-03T14:02:11Z] prefill: anchor_check pos=8192 expected=0x4f got=0x4f
[2024-06-03T14:02:11Z] prefill: anchor_check pos=8193 expected=0x6a got=0x6b <-- off by 1
```
ryan: hmm, looks like a RoPE phase/offset mismatch after restoring KV windows. did you see any fingerprint mismatches on KV sync?
lia: no fingerprint mismatches. fingerprints: before=0x9c3a after=0x9c3a for those runs.
omar: could be quant packing alignment when we copy KV pages between int4 packed buffers. any memcpy boundaries coincide with token indices?
sasha: I instrumented the warmstart path and saw an extra byte padding inserted by the new packer when a shard boundary aligns with 16-byte lanes. reproduction trace: `pack_offset=240` `pad_bytes=8`.
ryan: that padding could shift rotary embedding indexing if code uses raw pointer arithmetic without accounting for pad. check the ropemap offset calc: `kv_ptr + token_idx * elem_stride + pack_offset`.
lia: added assert in warmstart to recompute and validate RoPE table checksum after unpacking. checksum mismatches only when pad_bytes != 0.
omar: actionable plan: 1) add deterministic unit test for pack/unpack with nonzero pad, 2) adjust packer to emit explicit metadata about pad and align caller, 3) run 10k-anchor longprefill e2e. who can own?
sasha: I'll own the packer fix, will add metadata header 16B with pad info and a quick compatibility flag.
ryan: I'll add the RoPE checksum guard and unit tests. lia can you run the 10k-anchor loop on staging once patch is ready?
lia: yep. also, ops-bot started a canary: `deploy-bot: rollout/atlas-28k-int4-warmstart-fix canary -> stg-1 (1/4)`
omar: side note — we should log pack metadata in telemetry to correlate pad events with anchor diffs. add a metric `kv.pack.pad_bytes` tagged by shard.
sasha: will add metric and make packer emit it.
lia: thanks. summary: probable root cause = int4 packer padding causing pointer arithmetic mismatch affecting RoPE offsets after warmstart; not a KV data corruption (fingerprint OK). next steps assigned. :thumbsup:
